subject.title: feat(clickclack): session discussions — bound channels, side agent, lifecycle sync

question: Should ClickClack session discussions ship as a bundled optional feature that adds a shared scoped session-access capability, once the no-op tool exposure and live lifecycle proof are resolved?
rationale: The implementation adds a broad provider workflow, configuration surface, persisted bindings, and a shared plugin-SDK visibility mechanism; accepting that long-term product and compatibility boundary needs maintainer intent beyond a mechanical patch review.

options.title: Sponsor with bounded gating
options.body: Keep the feature in the bundled ClickClack plugin, require live proof and gate the tool to active bound sessions before merge.

options.title: Narrow to provider-only work
options.body: Retain managed-channel lifecycle work but defer shared scoped session access and side-agent relay until that SDK contract receives separate product review.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the provider implementation if bundled ClickClack discussions are not an intended maintained product surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with bounded gating
recommendation.body: Keep the feature in the bundled ClickClack plugin, require live proof and gate the tool to active bound sessions before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged generic seam this provider consumes and have the strongest direct context for the intended SDK and plugin boundary.
